items.title: Ran Blake interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 16, 2021
items.q: I said I want to go into an elegant drawing room and have a Agatha Christie mystery

ctx.x: Thank you. If you were to play something, I’m trying to think of the connection between your composing and your 80-some years of memories. Do you have memories that come to you, I mean I know that you had said something about trying to affect the way you dream.

Yes. And one time there was so much disease, racism, everything going on that I said I want to go into an elegant drawing room and have a Agatha Christie mystery where the murdered person is really a terrible person, so there’s no guilt about somebody’s death. I’ve tried that three or four times in the winter and only one time was I successful, but I have a lot of nightmares. I really like to be alone in my room because sometimes it can be noisy with some of my reflections.
Yeah. Well you certainly have made an impact on a lot of people, and I thank you for that. I also am appreciative of how quiet your cat was during the interview.
